H_FINITE_TRANSPORT.statement: X,Y,A,B are arbitrary finite types; m:X->A->R and n:Y->B->R are nonnegative; u:A->R, v:B->R, K:A->B->R are nonnegative; sum_x m(x,a)<=u(a) and sum_y n(y,b)<=v(b). Tuples are ((a,b),(x,y)) with weight K(a,b)m(x,a)n(y,b). A static side may use its retained static weight on a diagonal identity transport.
H_FINITE_TRANSPORT.needed_for: Dropping arbitrary restrictions and applying actual image-column capacities.

H_DIGIT_LIFTS.statement: The color is a finite product of finite additive commutative groups. For each coordinate and increment there is a bijection of expanded origin-link tuples adding that increment, preserving all other colors and the tuple weight. Selected bijections need no group law, freeness, or quotient section. For residue groups Z/q_i, every q_i>0.
H_DIGIT_LIFTS.needed_for: Exact zero-color factor 1/product_i |D_i|. Fiber equality alone permits signed real weights; the transport inequality uses H_FINITE_TRANSPORT.

H_RAW_UPDATE.statement: Actual raw link masses are nonnegative and their row sum M is at most the raw pre-weight w; actual success indicators lie in {0,1}; q=1/p with p prime; each transported indicator has orbit mean q and prefixes/link masses are constant under the pre-core orbit. Formal covariance equality only requires sum_G D=|G|qM and sum_G E=|G|qN; its upper bound requires M,N>=0. Nonnegative stopped loss uses actual nonnegative masses/indicators.
H_RAW_UPDATE.needed_for: Complementary retention, balanced deletion means, exact correlated covariance, and a nonnegative joint-success loss.

H_MASK_SUPPORT.statement: A nonzero link preserves the entire after-p mask, including later omissions and the present outer mask, and preserves width. The transported mask kernel is any nonnegative function of these tags. Broad currency is pi_I(a)pi_I(b); common-mask clipping currency is 1_(a=b)pi_I(a), not pi_I(a)^2.
H_MASK_SUPPORT.needed_for: Termwise preservation of outer currency through both column bounds.

H_ANCESTOR.statement: Current and origin label sets are finite, the same-location current-to-ancestor map is injective, and ancestor masses are nonnegative. Labels retain centre, original assigned row and numerator, even when locations coincide.
H_ANCESTOR.needed_for: No extra ancestor, processed-mask, future-mask or capacity copy after removing later congruences.

H_EPOCH.statement: Connectedness is an equivalence relation at every natural-number time and grows with time. Original endpoints first connect at J. Both replacements connect to their respective origins at one common time t<J. An unchanged newborn is extended as an isolated centre before birth.
H_EPOCH.needed_for: Preservation and uniqueness of the first-sharing epoch.

H_TRACE.statement: The trace is finite. Each continuation factor r_i>=0. Each local bound Q_i<=r_i Q_(i+1)+J_i holds, and J_i is the restricted zero-color loss of ChargeData satisfying H_FINITE_TRANSPORT and H_DIGIT_LIFTS. The formal trace assumes local bounds, not a global charge conclusion; ChargeData.loss_le_charge is derived.
H_TRACE.needed_for: Terminal carried product plus one nonnegative, separately stopped capacity charge per stage.

H_GRID_OPERATIONS.statement: Histories obey the manuscript's same-location projections, actual row/column-capacitated matching separately by width and complete after-p mask, full unprocessed-prime core equivariance, growing component chronology, stated cell spans, and nonincreasing clipping/testing multipliers. Later omissions are adaptive, squarefree by the good-mask excess-power bound and sufficiently large starting scale, and disjoint between mapped sides after passing all larger bad omissions. Tail exponents agree; earlier prefixes/links transport under each needed later-prime translation.
H_GRID_OPERATIONS.needed_for: The prose instantiation of the abstract finite implication. Existence and quantitative loss estimates for such histories are not consequences.

H_DOMAIN_AND_STATIC.statement: Equality is applied to the widened, prefix-only expanded majorant using original-minus numerator congruences. Later survival, clipping and partition predicates are dropped; any needed preliminary cell-span bound is extracted first. At fixed static anchor choices retain one active birth exclusion per prime or the prescribed scalar, average after the upper calculation, and keep adaptive multipliers computed from the actual averaged tables. Later projection multipliers are units at birth primes.
H_DOMAIN_AND_STATIC.needed_for: Avoiding an unsupported equality for actual final survivors or an independence assumption about matching plans and auxiliary static anchors.

H_RESTORE.statement: U,T,d,e are positive integers, B_i,B_j>=0, H=B_i+B_j+log(2UT), P0=rho*H, 0<d0<rho, and fixed C>=0. The masks obey sum_(p|d,p>d0 B_i) (log p)^0.3/p<=1 and sum_(p|e,p>d0 B_j) (log p)^0.3/p<=1. Products and sums use distinct prime divisors and R_p=1-1/p.
H_RESTORE.needed_for: The prose restoration product bound. In particular H>=B_i,B_j,log(UT) must not be omitted.

claim_versions.natural_statement: For every finite projected-table history obeying the stated core symmetries, mask transitions, and chronology, the backward expansion has one continuing branch and separately stopped nonnegative joint-loss terms. Expanding the later projections of each stopped term gives exactly the reciprocal of the product of its squarefree later omissions; summing origin links then costs at most the successful plus capacities, with the original outer currency unchanged and no repeated first-sharing epoch. No independence of success indicators or matching histories is required.
claim_versions.decisive_argument: Equal-fiber averaging followed by capacities, correlated raw covariance, injective labelled ancestors, growing chronology and finite one-branch unrolling; report sections 2-3.
claim_versions.supported_scope: Same conditional natural assertion as v2, interpreted on the expanded majorant rather than actual later-survivor density.
dependencies: The same finite mechanism subsequently bound to C_BC@2
claim_versions.attribution: Historical natural-statement version of the manuscript-mechanism verification, not a separately certified result.

claim_versions.natural_statement: For every finite projected-table history obeying the stated core symmetries, mask transitions, and chronology, the backward expansion has one continuing branch and separately stopped nonnegative joint-loss terms. Expanding the later projections of each stopped term gives exactly the reciprocal of the product of its squarefree later omissions; summing origin links then costs at most the successful plus capacities, with the original outer currency unchanged and no repeated first-sharing epoch. No independence of success indicators or matching histories is required.
claim_versions.decisive_argument: projected_transport proves the reciprocal factor before capacity. Raw covariance supplies separately stopped nonnegative joint losses without independence. The prose establishes original-minus digit lifts, actual residual capacities, complete tags, injective row ancestors and earlier-connected replacements; complete_backward_charge then unrolls any finite trace.
claim_versions.supported_scope: Universal finite implication plus the conditional pinned-source grid instantiation assessed in prose, not a kernel proof of that instantiation or a quantitative first-join theorem.
claim_versions.attribution: Formalization/reproduction of the source transport mechanism with conditional abstract digit/kernel generalizations.

claim_versions.natural_statement: Invariant weights on finite origin-link tuples have exactly equal color-fiber sums when each later-omission digit has an equivariant shift preserving the other digits. Consequently the zero fiber is the unrestricted sum divided by the product of digit-space cardinalities; no independence assumption on success indicators is used.
claim_versions.decisive_argument: Compose individual digit shifts, reindex equal-weight fibers, and sum over all colors. Translation by 1/l^nu moves the original-minus digit by a unit while preserving other digits, p-success and expanded-tuple weights. Its full prime-power order need not equal the quotient digit order.
claim_versions.supported_scope: Exact equality for the projection-only widened prefix majorant; arbitrary positive-modulus extension only if lifts are supplied. Not an equality for arbitrary later survival predicates.
claim_versions.attribution: Elementary finite averaging formalized for the manuscript's original-minus omissions, with a conditional abstract digit-space generalization.

claim_versions.natural_statement: For arbitrary correlated success indicators of orbit mean 1/p, the complementary matched/unpaired minus update has the exact raw covariance identity in join:raw-covariance. Dropping its nonnegative product-of-means subtraction gives a product continuation plus one nonnegative stopped joint-success loss.
claim_versions.decisive_argument: w+=(1-q)w-(D-qM), ED=qM, and E(w+v+)=(1-q)^2wv+E(DE)-q^2MN. Only q^2MN>=0 is dropped; no covariance or success correlation is set to zero.
claim_versions.supported_scope: Actual raw-mass coefficients and balanced individual orbit means, with residual plus factor R_p^[nu>=2] and both nu=1 and nu>=2 mask transitions distinguished.
claim_versions.attribution: Exact reproduction/formalization of join:raw-covariance, not a new independence claim.

claim_versions.natural_statement: Nonzero matching links preserve the complete after-p mask. Every nonnegative kernel of the two preserved masks, including independent outer laws and a single common outer law, is therefore carried unchanged through the two column-capacity bounds; the common law is not squared.
claim_versions.decisive_argument: Replace origin tags by image tags termwise on nonzero link support, then pull the single nonnegative image kernel outside both origin sums and apply column capacities.
claim_versions.supported_scope: Both manuscript currencies and arbitrary nonnegative correlated kernels of preserved tags, without normalization; no mask-selection or analytic kernel bound.
claim_versions.attribution: Reproduction of the one-law/product-law distinction with an algebraic correlated-kernel generalization.

claim_versions.natural_statement: Same-location projection maps each current assigned-row label injectively to its earlier ancestor label. After removing later congruences, summing origins in a fixed p-step matrix introduces no duplicate ancestor row, extra future-mask choice, or additional column capacity.
claim_versions.decisive_argument: For a fixed original assigned row, current numerator z maps to ancestor numerator bz and has a unique inverse on the divisible subgrid. The row fixes its complete mask, and all below-p masks are already rows of one actual matching matrix.
claim_versions.supported_scope: Labelled, not merely geometric, injectivity; dead labels can have zero weights and distinct coincident labels are not identified.
claim_versions.attribution: Finite injective-map inequality and source same-location row correspondence, not an additional capacity estimate.

claim_versions.natural_statement: In any growing equivalence-relation chronology, replacing endpoints by vertices connected to them at an earlier time preserves their first-sharing epoch. Hence one fixed charged image pair cannot be charged at two different first-sharing epochs.
claim_versions.decisive_argument: A hypothetical earlier connection of the replacements at s<J would connect the original endpoints at max(s,t)<J by growth and transitivity, contradicting first sharing.
claim_versions.supported_scope: Earlier-linked old endpoints, unchanged newborn static endpoints, and no repeated comparison epoch. Stopping primes and finite mapped-side choices may still be summed.
claim_versions.attribution: Elementary growing-equivalence argument formalizing the source capacity/uniqueness claim.

claim_versions.natural_statement: A finite sequence of nonnegative continuation factors and correlated one-step update bounds is dominated by the carried terminal product plus exactly one separately stopped projected-transport charge per step. No stopped term is expanded into a new covariance branch.
claim_versions.decisive_argument: Finite induction substitutes the tail bound only into the continuing prefix and applies derived loss<=charge at the current step, yielding product_i r_i times the terminal plus sum_i product_(j<i) r_j times charge_i.
claim_versions.supported_scope: Any finite length under the local update and transport hypotheses. No infinite/analytic stopping-prime summation and no kernel construction of an actual manuscript trace.
claim_versions.attribution: Finite recursive composition of the reproduced transport mechanism.

claim_versions.natural_statement: If P0=rho*H, d0<rho, and the two masks obey sum_{p|d,p>d0*B}(log p)^0.3/p<=1, then for every fixed C>=0 the product of R_p^(-C) over p>P0 dividing UTde is at most exp(2*C*(1/(rho*log 2)+2/(log 2)^0.3)), independently of the block and masks.
claim_versions.decisive_argument: The two mask reciprocal sums are each at most (log 2)^(-0.3), the UT contribution is at most log(UT)/(rho H log 2)<=1/(rho log 2), and -log(1-1/p)<=2/p for p>=2. Sum over the union of distinct prime supports and exponentiate.
claim_versions.supported_scope: The contextual fixed-cutoff product bound, with H=B_i+B_j+log(2UT), not a claim for arbitrary H.
dependencies: joins.tex definitions of H and P0
claim_versions.attribution: Explicit elementary reproduction of join:mismatch-restoration, not a new compiled theorem.
